lecture_beats.subject: Four formulations, planar Lorentz force, and zero magnetic work
Potentials, monopoles, action, space-time hint, and notation exchange
Gauge invariance, canonical momentum, and Euler-Lagrange recovery of the force
Uniform-field gauges, conserved momenta, circular motion, and q over m
Guiding center, dimensions, electric drift, Hall response, and Hamiltonian exercise
Poisson motivation, definition, evolution, and Hamilton equations
Antisymmetry, fundamental brackets, derivative action, linearity, and product rule
Algebraic mechanics and the quantum-mechanical outlook

resolved_source_issues.issue: The spoken board presentation reverses the magnetic orientation while rewriting gauges.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter fixes ordinary right-handed axes, takes the field into the page as minus B z-hat, and verifies both later conservation-law gauges by direct curl.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The spoken sign of omega is stated and immediately reconsidered.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The signed result omega_c=qB/m is derived from the displayed first-order velocity equations; the measurable magnitude is abs(q)B/m.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The factors qB are initially omitted while interpreting the orbit-center constants.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: Direct substitution gives p_x=qB y_0 and p_y=-qB x_0.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The transcript briefly says x direction after deriving y-directed motion.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The equations and subsequent explanation establish y-directed E over B drift.
The audience exchange is retained but limited to the standard sensing and commutation role of Hall devices.

resolved_source_issues.issue: A caption gap omits part of the written Hamilton equations.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The standard equations are fixed by the immediately following chain-rule derivation.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The closing nationality banter contains deliberately incorrect attributions.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: Only the accurate Heisenberg--Dirac quantum connection is retained.
